central_invariant: Issue authenticated harness date before invoking one generator; capture the native-normalized first candidate once; retain rejected candidates in the common A/B population; preserve common RCC review before treatment and RCC-only A; require B's date profile after RCC, at native Bind constraints and final native dispatch without bypassing existing governance gates.

integration_boundary.scope: Task4 immediate refund, pinned AgentDojo send_money simulator only; additive controlled-candidate runner, separate from frozen v2.8 Final128 CLI.
integration_boundary.generation: The callable receives the original request, detached pre-state and independently issued execution date, never a key, issuer or model/scorer-selected clock. Exactly one invocation per case/proposal; no automatic retry or candidate repair.
integration_boundary.normalization: Exact native argument shape, Pydantic normalization, RCC CandidateAction full shape, immutable common capture, Pairwise Protected Candidate Control V1.1 identity.
integration_boundary.eligibility_refusal_population: V1 profile stores a first candidate before checking its date/refund bindings. Only the two documented eligibility refusals are retained for A/B; context authentication, scope, freshness and structural failures abort capture. No candidate repair or exclusion based on B eligibility.
integration_boundary.pairing_identity: SHA256(control_identity_sha256, authenticated date_context_digest, candidate_sha256), additional to the unchanged V1.1 control identity; shared by both arms.
integration_boundary.arm_a: Native RCC-only review and dispatch with common candidate/pre-state integrity. B date eligibility, date expiry and refund predicates do not gate A.
integration_boundary.arm_b: Retained date/refund refusal yields zero native dispatch; eligible capture is reverified after RCC, in native Bind constraints and at the actual native effect sink.
integration_boundary.date_gap_composition: Only supported_profile/date_authority_present in the exact pre-existing Task4 resolver schema are fulfilled by a successfully verified V1 date context and exact candidate/pre-state. Recipient/amount checks remain unchanged; resolver schema drift fails closed.
native_governance_gates: Task4 known, preregistered conditional mutation policy
native Bind state-drift and runtime-risk checks
date/candidate/live pre-state recheck at the native dispatch sink
exact one-record native ledger transition and postcondition receipt
integration_boundary.direct_callback_bypass: Effect callback rejects outside an admitted apply scope; retained adapter.apply rejects outside active native Bind. One arm attempt per capture, one native sink attempt; no durable exactly-once claim.
integration_boundary.native_bind_timestamps: Existing Bind wall-clock timestamp semantics are retained; date-profile clock is a separate authenticated metadata source. Synthetic date-clock fixtures do not attest physical time.
integration_boundary.trust_boundary: Trusted Python harness owns generator selection, request/state provenance, session keys, registry, code and policy configuration. HMAC/labels/hashes cannot establish clock truth or user authenticity. No arbitrary trusted-Python compromise protection is claimed.
integration_boundary.fault_probes: Positive path uses actual pinned native RCC/Bind/AgentDojo implementations. Explicit negative fault probes replace only the boundary being attacked; they are development tests, not independent validation.

offline_proof.clock_fixture: Harness-owned 2031-07-08 UTC; independent of historical incoming date 2005-02-03 and observed/gold dates.
